blocks.text: A North Korean official considered to be one of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un’s closest aides has arrived in Russia, the North’s state media said Sunday, amid deepening relations between the two countries following North Korea’s deployment of troops to support Russia’s war against Ukraine. Jo Yong-won, secretary of the Central Committee of the ruling Workers’ Party, arrived in Moscow by private plane on Saturday, leading a party and government delegation, the Korean Central News Agency said.
